theorem: Selector Z-Min Sheet Design Theorem.  The 108 unique golden-selector failure supports are actual minimal Z logical supports.  Their orbit under PSp(4,3) is a 120-sheet design with sheet stabilizer 216=8*27.  Every one of the 1620 minimal Z supports lies in exactly eight sheets, so 120*108 = 1620*8 = 12960.  The square D4 factor is therefore both the ordering torsor of one failed quadrangle and the incidence multiplicity of the global selector-sheet design.
title: Golden selector failures form a 120-sheet Z-min design
